regulations.enforcement_body: City of Pittsburgh Department of Permits, Licenses, and Inspections (PLI)
regulations.notes: As of December 19, 2024, Pittsburgh launched a Residential Housing Rental Permit Program requiring all rental properties to obtain permits. STRs are relatively unrestricted — both owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied are permitted. The program was in voluntary compliance until June 1, 2025. Pennsylvania hotel tax must be collected.
